actions.description: Grants permission to obtain a set of temporary security credentials that you can use to access AWS resources that you might not normally have access to
actions.name: AssumeRole

actions.description: Grants permission to obtain a set of temporary security credentials for users who have been authenticated via a SAML authentication response
actions.name: AssumeRoleWithSAML

actions.description: Grants permission to obtain a set of temporary security credentials for users who have been authenticated in a mobile or web application with a web identity provider
actions.name: AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity

actions.description: Grants permission to obtain a set of temporary security credentials that you can use to perform privileged tasks in member accounts in your organization
actions.name: AssumeRoot

actions.description: Grants permission to decode additional information about the authorization status of a request from an encoded message returned in response to an AWS request
actions.name: DecodeAuthorizationMessage

actions.description: Grants permission to obtain details about the access key id passed as a parameter to the request
actions.name: GetAccessKeyInfo

actions.description: Grants permission to obtain details about the IAM identity whose credentials are used to call the API
actions.name: GetCallerIdentity

actions.description: Returns temporary security credentials for accessing an AWS account after temporary delegation request approval. This API requires the tradeInToken provided upon request delegation approval and is intended to be used only by Amazon or AWS Partners
actions.name: GetDelegatedAccessToken

actions.description: Grants permission to obtain a set of temporary security credentials (consisting of an access key ID, a secret access key, and a security token) for a federated user
actions.name: GetFederationToken

actions.description: Grants permission to obtain a STS bearer token for an AWS root user, IAM role, or an IAM user
actions.name: GetServiceBearerToken

actions.description: Grants permission to obtain a set of temporary security credentials (consisting of an access key ID, a secret access key, and a security token) for an AWS account or IAM user
actions.name: GetSessionToken

actions.description: Grants permission to obtain a short-lived, publicly verifiable JSON Web Token (JWT) that represents the calling IAM principal's identity
actions.name: GetWebIdentityToken

actions.description: Grants permission to set context keys on a STS session
actions.name: SetContext

actions.description: Grants permission to set a source identity on a STS session
actions.name: SetSourceIdentity

actions.description: Grants permission to add tags to the JSON Web Token (JWT) generated by the GetWebIdentityToken API
actions.name: TagGetWebIdentityToken

actions.description: Grants permission to add tags to a STS session
actions.name: TagSession
